blocks.x: Energy per site down 18% — telemetry-driven optimization at 12,000 sites
A Middle East operator group — Telecom, Media & Entertainment engagement delivered by a 14-person team over 11 months, Middle East scope, commercial model: build-transfer.

items: Per-site energy uninstrumented; optimization anecdotal; ESG reporting manual.
Site incidents (power, climate, security) found by outage.
Commitment strategy unused; cloud spend escalating.

blocks.x: We instrumented site-level energy and environment telemetry, built the optimization models (load-shaping, equipment scheduling, temperature policies), and delivered the ESG data spine with lineage for disclosure. Site incidents now predicted; cloud commitments rightsized with utilization tracking.
A Middle East operator group uses the standard Achala delivery pattern — nothing bespoke about the governance, everything bespoke about the design. That split is deliberate.

items: The measured delta and the method note are written up on the case page — anonymized by agreement, baseline audited.
You can read the shape of this engagement on the case page: baseline locked early, outcome measured against it, method available under NDA.

blocks.x: Towers: Cloud, Edge & Platform Engineering, IoT, Digital Twin & Robotics, Data, Analytics & Lakehouse. Platforms: BI & Analytics Platform, Fleet Management System.

items: What moved unchanged between sectors, and why it was safe to move — stated plainly.
What does not transfer between estates, and the adaptation it needs — named before the pilot, not after.

blocks.x: Anonymity is contractual; the measurement discipline is not — the same gates and evidence standards apply on every engagement.
Run the same diagnostic on your estate: the baseline that anchored this program takes two weeks, and yours is measured the same way.
